en.t: The woman did not flinch at all.
She said that my answer was a lie.

units.source_text: 尔后值得提及的是，她小心翼翼地试图说服我，而又不伤害我的自尊心。

en.t: What deserves mention afterward is that she carefully tried to persuade me without wounding my pride.

units.source_text: 对她来说，竟有男人不爱她，是出乎意料之外的。

en.t: To her, it was beyond expectation that there could be a man who did not love her.

units.source_text: 倘使有这种男人，也是他在欺骗他自己。

en.t: If such a man existed, he too was only deceiving himself.

units.source_text: 于是，她对我做了一番大胆的精细分析，终于认定我实际上早就爱上了她。

en.t: So she made a bold and minute analysis of me, and finally concluded that I had in fact long since fallen in love with her.

units.source_text: 假定她真的爱我，那么她就是爱上了一个手足无措的对象。

en.t: Supposing that she truly loved me, then she had fallen in love with an object at a complete loss.

units.source_text: 她计算过，倘使把我的并不美的脸蛋说成是美，就会让我生气；

en.t: She had calculated that if she called my not at all beautiful face beautiful, it would make me angry;

units.source_text: 倘使把我的X型的腿说成是美，就会使我恼火；

en.t: if she called my X shaped legs beautiful, it would irritate me;

units.source_text: 倘使她爱的不是我的外表，而是我的内在美，就会引起我更大的愤怒。

en.t: if what she loved was not my appearance but my inner beauty, it would provoke even greater anger in me.

units.source_text: 因此，她只是继续说她"爱着"我，并且通过对我内心所做的分析，找出了与之相应的感情来。

en.t: Therefore she simply went on saying that she loved me, and through her analysis of my inner self she found the feelings that corresponded to it.
